hedges.reason: This is the most direct instrument for the shared-beta thesis. HYPE is the collateral and wealth base of HyperEVM. A strong HYPE run means lots of HYPE-denominated liquidity and airdrop wealth looking for new ecosystem tokens, and that is the world where Hyperbeat's day-1 FDV clears $300-400M and C6 and C7 NO lose.

Felix is a HyperEVM lending protocol and a close peer of Hyperbeat, so its token would be priced by the same investors, in the same ecosystem, under similar airdrop dynamics. A richly valued Felix launch shows the ecosystem is putting high FDVs on new tokens, which is the world where Hyperbeat blows through my upper strikes.

claims.reason: A day-1 FDV above $400M for a mid-tier HyperEVM yield protocol needs strong ecosystem risk appetite and deep HYPE-denominated liquidity. Such a launch is very unlikely while HYPE is stagnant or falling. HYPE making at least a modest new high before year-end should go with it.
